title: Loudon Live — rich
forward_vector: I am the manifest of Loudon Live's rich face: what was made for each section, and the fingerprint of the words each piece was made against, so the page can say when a piece may lag the text. I grow when the entry is enriched again; I never hold the entry's words.
note: A light face, from the light round of 2026-11, third batch: one small thing beside one sentence, not a walk up to a test. Made by the working session (a child) in Enrichment/light-round-2026-11/, where the makers and data stay; placed here by the Concierge. A challenger has now read this piece (2026-11-11); its verdict is in the section's challenge block. It was made before the challenge of the first forty came back (16 keep, 24 remake), so it likely carries the same kinds of fault that challenge found: a caption that reads more into the page than the page says, a 'what is real' line that owns too little, a count off by one where a parser was naive. Every section is a proposal until Loudon approves it.

pieces.file: Loudon Live — rich — the trace, heard.m4a
pieces.title: The trace, heard
pieces.caption: Press play; the picture beneath says what you are hearing. *What is real and what is a choice:* 220 and 330 Hz, the right ear a sixteenth of a hertz sharp so the figure turns. A flat two-tone cousin of the mark, not the mark itself: the channel's mark runs three frequencies at 3:4:6 in three dimensions. The fifth and 220 Hz are the maker's choices. The picture is drawn from the same two numbers, not from the audio. Both ears sit at -4.7 dB RMS, loud for bare sine, and nobody has listened. *Leaking in:* Rational Hearing, which carries '3:2 the fifth'; neither page links the other.

pieces.file: Loudon Live — rich — the trace, heard — picture.svg
pieces.title: The trace, heard · drawn
pieces.caption: A low tone in the left ear and one a fifth above it in the right, and the figure those two draw when one moves a dot sideways and the other moves it up and down. It passes through the same shape every eight seconds; a whole turn takes sixteen.

challenge.by: challenger · light round, batch F (six sounds and four diagrams with numbers) · read-only dispatch

verdicts.file: Loudon Live — rich — the trace, heard.m4a
verdicts.why: The sound and the figure are exactly what they say, and hearing the channel's mark as an interval is a real hook. Two words are off: the drawn shape comes home every eight seconds, not sixteen, and the honest line does not own that this is not the channel's mark, which runs three frequencies at 3:4:6 in three dimensions (`_ops/loudon-live/design-system/assets/logo-lissajous.live.html`), where this is two at 2:3 on a flat disc.
